notes.meaning: God gives Ezekiel a new message, aimed at Mount Seir. Mount Seir is the rugged hill country where the Edomites lived. They came from Esau, the brother of Jacob. Edom is singled out because it hated God's people so bitterly, and it stands for all the enemies of God's people.

God says plainly, "I am against you." He will reach out His hand and turn Edom's land into an empty waste, with its cities in ruins. Then Edom will learn by hard experience that He is the LORD. As Matthew Henry puts it, those who have God against them also have His word against them.
